instruments.title: Add Wft, the Dutch Financial Supervision Act (Wet op het financieel toezicht)
instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, first published in Stb. 2006, 475; consolidated text in force from 2026-09-29, read in its XML file; entry into force on 2007-01-01 read in the royal decree in Stb. 2006, 664 (Officiële bekendmakingen)

titles.nl: Wet van 28 september 2006, houdende regels met betrekking tot de financiële markten en het toezicht daarop (Wet op het financieel toezicht)
titles.en: Financial Supervision Act

obligations.title: Add the duty: Cap variable pay at 20 per cent of fixed annual pay
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 1:121 lid 1 tot en met 3 en 7, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=1:121

titles.en: Cap variable pay at 20 per cent of fixed annual pay

summaries.en: A financial undertaking with its seat in the Netherlands may award a person working under its responsibility variable remuneration of at most 20 per cent of that person's fixed annual remuneration. In exceptional cases it may award more, up to 100 per cent, to a person who works mainly in the Netherlands, is not wholly paid under a collective agreement and neither performs an internal control function nor deals directly with financial services to consumers, provided the average ratio for all such staff stays at or below 20 per cent; for staff working mainly in another state the limit is that of the Capital Requirements Directive. The cap does not apply to managers of investment funds and of UCITS or to investment firms that deal only on own account without external clients.

payload.refLabel: art. 1:121 lid 1 tot en met 3 en 7

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have day-to-day policy and internal supervision carried out by suitable persons
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 3:8 lid 1 en 3, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=3:8

titles.en: Have day-to-day policy and internal supervision carried out by suitable persons

summaries.en: The day-to-day policy of a bank, insurer, payment institution, e-money institution or other financial undertaking listed in the article with its seat in the Netherlands must be determined by persons who are suitable for carrying on its business, and any body supervising policy and the general course of affairs must consist of persons suitable for that supervision. The composition and functioning of a bank's management and supervisory body must also meet Article 91 of the Capital Requirements Directive, parts of which the article applies only to significant banks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pursue an adequate policy that safeguards the integrity of the business
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 3:10 lid 1 en 3, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=3:10

titles.en: Pursue an adequate policy that safeguards the integrity of the business

summaries.en: A bank, insurer, payment institution, e-money institution or other financial undertaking listed in the article with its seat in the Netherlands must pursue an adequate policy that safeguards the integrity of its business: it counters conflicts of interest, offences and other breaches of the law by the firm or its employees, relationships with clients that can harm confidence in the firm or the financial markets, and other conduct contrary to generally accepted standards that can seriously harm that confidence. It must give De Nederlandsche Bank the information on related incidents that is set by decree.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Organise the business so that it is carried on in a sound and controlled way
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 3:17 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=3:17

titles.en: Organise the business so that it is carried on in a sound and controlled way

summaries.en: A bank, insurer, payment institution, e-money institution or other financial undertaking listed in the article with its seat in the Netherlands must organise its operations so that its business is carried on in a controlled and sound way. The rules set by decree under the article cover the control of business processes and risks, integrity, the firm's financial soundness including, for a bank, a recovery plan, records that do not hinder the deposit guarantee scheme, and the proper working of payments.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure that a third party to whom work is outsourced follows the prudential rules, and keep designated work in house
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 3:18 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=3:18

titles.en: Ensure that a third party to whom work is outsourced follows the prudential rules, and keep designated work in house

summaries.en: A financial undertaking with its seat in the Netherlands that outsources work to a third party must ensure that the third party complies with the rules of the prudential part of the act that apply to the firm for that work. A bank, insurer, payment institution, e-money institution or other firm listed in the article may not outsource the work that a decree designates.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Safeguard the funds received from payment service users and for electronic money
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 3:29a, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=3:29a

titles.en: Safeguard the funds received from payment service users and for electronic money

summaries.en: A payment institution or e-money institution with its seat in the Netherlands must safeguard the funds it receives from payment service users or from other payment or e-money institutions, in the way art. 3:29aa sets out or a decree prescribes, and an e-money institution must do the same for funds received in exchange for electronic money. The first duty does not apply to a payment institution that provides only the payment services numbered 7 and 8 in the annex to the Payment Services Directive.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File periodic returns with De Nederlandsche Bank within the set deadlines
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 3:72 lid 1 en 7, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=3:72

titles.en: File periodic returns with De Nederlandsche Bank within the set deadlines

summaries.en: A bank, payment institution, e-money institution, investment firm, manager of a UCITS or Dutch manager of an investment fund, and the other firms listed in the article, must periodically provide De Nederlandsche Bank, within the deadlines set, with the returns it needs to supervise the prudential rules, on a consolidated basis where required. The returns of a bank, manager, payment institution or e-money institution must periodically carry an auditor's statement that they give a true and fair view.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Handle complaints through an internal procedure and belong to the designated dispute resolution body
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 4:17 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=4:17

titles.en: Handle complaints through an internal procedure and belong to the designated dispute resolution body

summaries.en: A payment service provider, a financial service provider, an investment firm that provides investment services, a manager of a UCITS, a clearing institution or a credit servicer must ensure that complaints from clients, consumers, participants or borrowers about its services or products are handled adequately. It must have an internal complaints procedure aimed at swift and careful handling and must be affiliated to the dispute resolution body the Minister has designated, unless it provides investment services only to professional investors or acts as a clearing institution.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make all information to clients, advertising included, correct, clear and not misleading
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 4:19 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=4:19

titles.en: Make all information to clients, advertising included, correct, clear and not misleading

summaries.en: A financial undertaking must ensure that information it gives or makes available on a financial product, financial service or ancillary service, including advertising and investment research, is correct, clear and not misleading, does not detract from the information the act requires, and can be recognised as commercial where it has a commercial purpose. The article does not apply to advertising by managers of investment funds, managers of UCITS and credit servicers.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base advice and portfolio management on the client's position, knowledge, objectives and risk appetite
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 4:23 lid 1, 3 en 4, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=4:23

titles.en: Base advice and portfolio management on the client's position, knowledge, objectives and risk appetite

summaries.en: A financial undertaking that advises a consumer, or a client in the case of a financial instrument or insurance, or manages an individual portfolio must obtain information on the person's financial position, knowledge, experience, objectives and risk appetite as far as reasonably relevant, and base its advice or management on it; for products other than financial instruments it explains the reasoning behind the advice. An investment firm that advises a retail investor must give a suitability statement on a durable medium with the advice or in any case before the transaction, and a periodic suitability statement when it manages the portfolio.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess a consumer's financial position before lending and refuse credit that would be irresponsible
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 4:34 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=4:34

titles.en: Assess a consumer's financial position before lending and refuse credit that would be irresponsible

summaries.en: Before a credit agreement is concluded or the credit limit or the amounts made available are raised significantly, an offeror of credit must obtain information on the consumer's financial position and assess, to prevent overindebtedness, whether the agreement or the increase is responsible. It may not conclude the agreement or grant the increase where that would be irresponsible in view of the consumer's overindebtedness.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Organise an investment fund manager so that conflicts of interest are identified, prevented, managed and monitored
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 4:37e lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=4:37e

titles.en: Organise an investment fund manager so that conflicts of interest are identified, prevented, managed and monitored

summaries.en: The manager of an investment fund must organise its operations so that measures can be taken to identify, prevent, manage and monitor possible conflicts of interest, and must take measures to prevent the interests of the funds it manages or their participants from being harmed by a conflict. Where harm to participants' interests cannot be prevented, it must inform potential participants of the nature of the possible conflicts and pursue an adequate policy for dealing with them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer consumers lawfully resident in the EU a basic payment account in euro
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 4:71f, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=4:71f

titles.en: Offer consumers lawfully resident in the EU a basic payment account in euro

summaries.en: A bank that offers payment accounts to consumers in the Netherlands must let consumers who reside lawfully in the European Union, including those without a fixed address and asylum seekers, apply for and use a basic payment account in euro regardless of nationality or place of residence. It must open the account within ten working days of the complete application unless a ground for refusal in art. 4:71g applies, may not make other products a condition, must offer the services free of charge or for a reasonable fee, and may not offer basic accounts only over the internet.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Protect clients' rights to their money and financial instruments and do not use them for own account
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, art. 4:87 lid 1 en 3, text in force from 2026-09-29; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020368&artikel=4:87

titles.en: Protect clients' rights to their money and financial instruments and do not use them for own account

summaries.en: An investment firm must take adequate measures to protect clients' rights to the money and financial instruments that belong to them and to prevent their use for the firm's own account, except, for financial instruments, with the client's express consent. A tied agent may not hold financial instruments or money belonging to a client.

instruments.title: Add Wwft, the Dutch act on preventing money laundering and terrorist financing (Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme)
instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, first published in Stb. 2008, 303; consolidated text in force from 2026-07-01, read in its XML file; entry into force on 2008-08-01 read in the royal decree in Stb. 2008, 304 (Officiële bekendmakingen)

titles.nl: Wet van 15 juli 2008, houdende samenvoeging van de Wet identificatie bij dienstverlening en de Wet melding ongebruikelijke transacties (Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme)
titles.en: Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (Prevention) Act

payload.officialRef: Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme (Stb. 2008, 303)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify and assess the firm's own money laundering and terrorist financing risks and keep the assessment up to date
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 2b lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=2b

titles.en: Identify and assess the firm's own money laundering and terrorist financing risks and keep the assessment up to date

summaries.en: An institution must take measures, in proportion to its nature and size, to identify and assess its risks of money laundering and terrorist financing, taking into account at least the risk factors tied to the type of customer, product, service, transaction and delivery channel and to countries or geographic areas. It must record the results, keep them up to date and give them to the supervisory authority on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have policies, procedures and measures that limit and control money laundering risks, approved by the day-to-day policymakers
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 2c, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=2c

titles.en: Have policies, procedures and measures that limit and control money laundering risks, approved by the day-to-day policymakers

summaries.en: An institution must have policies, procedures and measures to limit and effectively control its risks of money laundering and terrorist financing and the risks named in the latest supranational and national risk assessments. They must be proportionate to its nature and size, cover at least risk management, group rules, customer due diligence, the reporting duty, record keeping and training, and be approved by the persons who determine its day-to-day policy. The institution must test them systematically and adjust them where needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Name a policymaker responsible for compliance with the act and keep independent compliance and audit functions
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 2d, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=2d

titles.en: Name a policymaker responsible for compliance with the act and keep independent compliance and audit functions

summaries.en: Where two or more persons determine the institution's day-to-day policy, it must designate one of them as responsible for its compliance with the act. As far as fits its nature and size, it must have an independent and effective compliance function, which checks compliance with the law and with internal rules and makes the reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit, and must have an audit function carried out independently that checks compliance with the act and the work of the compliance function.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply group-wide anti-money laundering policies, including in branches and majority-owned subsidiaries abroad
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 2f lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=2f

titles.en: Apply group-wide anti-money laundering policies, including in branches and majority-owned subsidiaries abroad

summaries.en: An institution that is part of a group must effectively apply the group's policies and procedures, including those on data protection and on sharing information within the group, as far as they meet the act, and must ensure that its branches and majority-owned subsidiaries established outside the Netherlands apply them. Where the law of a non-member state prevents this, it must inform the supervisory authority and see to it that the branch or subsidiary takes additional measures to control the risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out customer due diligence when entering a business relationship and in the other cases the act lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 3 lid 1, 2 en 5, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=3

titles.en: Carry out customer due diligence when entering a business relationship and in the other cases the act lists

summaries.en: An institution must carry out customer due diligence that lets it identify the customer and verify the identity, identify the ultimate beneficial owner and take reasonable measures to verify that identity and to understand the ownership and control structure, establish the purpose and intended nature of the relationship, monitor the relationship and its transactions continuously, check that a representative is authorised, and check whether the customer acts for a third party. It does so when it enters a business relationship in or from the Netherlands, carries out an occasional transaction of at least 15,000 euros or a transfer of funds of at least 1,000 euros, sees indications of money laundering or terrorist financing, doubts earlier data, or where the risk of an existing customer or the customer's state gives cause.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Match due diligence demonstrably to the risk and keep customer data up to date
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 3 lid 7, 8 en 10, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=3

titles.en: Match due diligence demonstrably to the risk and keep customer data up to date

summaries.en: An institution must demonstrably tailor its customer due diligence to the sensitivity to money laundering or terrorist financing of the type of customer, business relationship, product or transaction, taking into account at least the risk variables in Annex I to the fourth anti-money laundering directive. It must take reasonable measures to keep the data collected on customers, beneficial owners and representatives up to date, and must update them in any case when relevant circumstances of the customer change or when the act or the EU directive on administrative cooperation in taxation requires it to contact the customer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify and verify the customer and the beneficial owner before the relationship starts or the transaction is carried out
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 4 lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=4

titles.en: Identify and verify the customer and the beneficial owner before the relationship starts or the transaction is carried out

summaries.en: An institution must have identified the customer and the ultimate beneficial owner and verified their identity before it enters the business relationship or carries out the occasional transaction, and for a new relationship with a legal entity it must hold proof of the customer's registration in the trade register and establish whether its beneficial owners are registered there. It may verify while the relationship is being established where that is needed not to disrupt the service and the risk is low, and then as soon as possible after first contact. A bank or other financial undertaking may open an account before verification only if it ensures that the account cannot be used until verification has taken place.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not enter a relationship or carry out a transaction without completed due diligence, and end a relationship where it cannot be completed
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 5 lid 1 en 3, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=5

titles.en: Do not enter a relationship or carry out a transaction without completed due diligence, and end a relationship where it cannot be completed

summaries.en: An institution may not enter a business relationship with a customer or carry out a transaction for a customer unless due diligence under art. 3 has been carried out, by itself or by one of the introducing institutions the article lists, it has led to the required result, and the institution holds all identification and verification data. If it cannot meet the due diligence requirements for a business relationship, it must end that relationship. The cases of simplified due diligence in art. 6 and 7 are excepted.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not hold a correspondent relationship with a shell bank
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 5 lid 5, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=5

titles.en: Do not hold a correspondent relationship with a shell bank

summaries.en: A bank or other financial undertaking may not enter or continue a correspondent relationship with a shell bank, or with a bank or other financial undertaking known to allow a shell bank to use its accounts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced due diligence to higher-risk relationships and transactions and examine complex or unusual transactions
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 8 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=8

titles.en: Apply enhanced due diligence to higher-risk relationships and transactions and examine complex or unusual transactions

summaries.en: An institution must carry out enhanced customer due diligence at least where the business relationship or transaction by its nature carries a higher risk of money laundering or terrorist financing, judged at least by the risk factors of Annex III to the fourth anti-money laundering directive, and where the customer's state is one the European Commission has designated as higher risk. It must take reasonable measures to examine the background and purpose of complex or unusually large transactions and of transactions with an unusual pattern or without a clear economic or lawful purpose, and then put the whole relationship under enhanced monitoring.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess a respondent institution outside the EU before starting a correspondent relationship
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 8 lid 4, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=8

titles.en: Assess a respondent institution outside the EU before starting a correspondent relationship

summaries.en: A bank or other financial undertaking that enters a correspondent relationship involving payments with a respondent institution in a non-member state must gather enough information to understand the respondent's business and assess its reputation and the quality of its supervision, assess its anti-money laundering procedures and measures, have senior management decide on or approve a new relationship, and record each party's responsibilities. It must ensure that the respondent has identified and monitors the customers with direct access to payable-through accounts, and must document a decision to end the relationship for reasons of money laundering or terrorist financing.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Detect politically exposed persons and apply senior approval, source of wealth checks and enhanced monitoring
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 8 lid 6, 8, 9 en 10, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=8

titles.en: Detect politically exposed persons and apply senior approval, source of wealth checks and enhanced monitoring

summaries.en: An institution must have risk-based procedures to determine whether a customer or ultimate beneficial owner is a politically exposed person. For such a person, and for family members and known close associates, it needs the consent of a member of senior management to enter or continue the relationship or carry out the transaction, must take appropriate measures to establish the source of wealth and of the funds used, and must keep the relationship under continuous enhanced monitoring. After the person leaves the prominent public function it applies appropriate risk-based measures for as long as needed and for at least 12 months.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply the listed enhanced measures to business linked to high-risk third countries
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 9 lid 1, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=9

titles.en: Apply the listed enhanced measures to business linked to high-risk third countries

summaries.en: For transactions, business relationships and correspondent banking relationships related to states the European Commission has designated as higher risk, an institution must collect additional information on the customers and beneficial owners, on the purpose and nature of the relationship, on the origin of the funds and the source of wealth, and on the background and reasons for the transactions. It must obtain senior management approval to enter or continue the relationship and monitor it more closely, with more frequent checks and data updates and the selection of transaction patterns for further examination.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report discrepancies in beneficial ownership data to the Chamber of Commerce
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 10c lid 1, 3 en 5, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=10c

titles.en: Report discrepancies in beneficial ownership data to the Chamber of Commerce

summaries.en: An institution must report to the Chamber of Commerce every discrepancy it finds between data on an ultimate beneficial owner that it obtained from the trade register or the trust register and the information on that person it holds from other sources, giving the data it holds. The duty does not apply where it reports an unusual transaction to the Financial Intelligence Unit under art. 16.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report unusual transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 16 lid 1, 2 en 4, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=16

titles.en: Report unusual transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay

summaries.en: An institution must report a completed or intended unusual transaction to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay after its unusual nature has become known, with the identity of the customer and the beneficial owners, the identity document details, the nature, time and place of the transaction, the amount, origin and destination of the funds or other values, and the circumstances that make it unusual. The duty also applies where due diligence does not lead to the required result or a relationship is ended for that reason and there are indications that the customer is involved in money laundering or terrorist financing.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the Financial Intelligence Unit the further information it asks for without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 17 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=17

titles.en: Give the Financial Intelligence Unit the further information it asks for without delay

summaries.en: An institution that the Financial Intelligence Unit asks for data or information, because it made a report or because the Unit considers that it holds data relevant to analysing a transaction or a business relationship, must provide it without delay in writing, and orally in urgent cases.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give staff an independent channel to report breaches of the act anonymously
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 20a lid 1, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=20a

titles.en: Give staff an independent channel to report breaches of the act anonymously

summaries.en: An institution must have adequate arrangements, fitting its nature and size, that let its employees and persons in a comparable position report a breach of the act internally and anonymously through a specific, independent channel.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit secret from the customer and everyone else
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 23 lid 1, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=23

titles.en: Keep reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit secret from the customer and everyone else

summaries.en: An institution and the persons working for it must keep secret from everyone that a report has been made under art. 16, that further information has been given under art. 17, that a report or disclosure has led or may lead to an investigation into money laundering or terrorist financing, and any consultation on whether a transaction must be reported, except where the act requires disclosure. The article allows the communications it lists, among them within a group and between institutions of the same category about a shared customer and transaction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep due diligence records retrievable for five years after the relationship ends or the transaction is carried out
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 33 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=33

titles.en: Keep due diligence records retrievable for five years after the relationship ends or the transaction is carried out

summaries.en: An institution must record in a retrievable way the documents and data it used for customer due diligence, including the name, date of birth, address and identity document details of natural persons, the identity and verification data of beneficial owners, and the legal form, names, address and registration number of companies. It must keep them accessible for five years after the business relationship ends or after the transaction is carried out.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have systems that answer the Financial Intelligence Unit and the supervisor fully and without delay through secure channels
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 33 lid 4 en 5, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=33

titles.en: Have systems that answer the Financial Intelligence Unit and the supervisor fully and without delay through secure channels

summaries.en: An institution must have systems that let it respond without delay and in full to questions from the Financial Intelligence Unit and the supervisory authority, including whether it has or had a business relationship with a given customer in the five years before the request and what the nature of that relationship is. The systems must provide secure channels that keep the requests confidential.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the data of every reported unusual transaction for five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 34, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=34

titles.en: Keep the data of every reported unusual transaction for five years

summaries.en: An institution that has reported an unusual transaction must record in a retrievable way all the data needed to reconstruct the transaction, a copy of the report with the information given, and the Financial Intelligence Unit's acknowledgement of receipt. It must keep these accessible for five years after the report was made or the acknowledgement was received.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Screen and train employees and day-to-day policymakers
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, art. 35, text in force from 2026-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024282&artikel=35

titles.en: Screen and train employees and day-to-day policymakers

summaries.en: An institution must ensure that its employees and, as far as relevant to their tasks and in view of its risks, nature and size, its day-to-day policymakers are screened, know the provisions of the act and receive periodic training that enables them to recognise an unusual transaction and to carry out customer due diligence properly and completely.

instruments.title: Add Sanctiewet 1977, the Dutch framework act for carrying out international sanctions
instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctiewet 1977, BWBR0003296, first published in Stb. 1980, 93; consolidated text in force from 2025-03-01, read in its XML file; entry into force on 1980-04-21 read in the same file, in the title's source data (which name Stb. 1980, 170)

titles.nl: Wet van 15 februari 1980, tot het treffen van sancties tegen bepaalde staten of gebieden
titles.en: Sanctions Act 1977

instruments.title: Add Wtt 2018, the Dutch act on the supervision of trust offices (Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018)
instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, first published in Stb. 2018, 443; consolidated text in force from 2025-03-01, read in its XML file; entry into force on 2019-01-01 read in the royal decree in Stb. 2018, 464 (Officiële bekendmakingen)

titles.nl: Wet van 7 november 2018, houdende regels met betrekking tot het verlenen van trustdiensten en het toezicht daarop (Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018)
titles.en: Trust Offices Supervision Act 2018

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide trust services only with a licence from De Nederlandsche Bank
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 3 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=3

titles.en: Provide trust services only with a licence from De Nederlandsche Bank

summaries.en: Nobody with a seat in the Netherlands may provide trust services as a profession or business without a licence from De Nederlandsche Bank, and nobody with a seat in another member state may provide them to the Netherlands or from a Dutch branch without one, unless it holds a comparable licence under adequate supervision and has no branch in the Netherlands. A party with a seat outside the member states may not provide trust services to the Netherlands or from a Dutch branch at all.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have at least two natural persons determine day-to-day policy from the Netherlands
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 11, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=11

titles.en: Have at least two natural persons determine day-to-day policy from the Netherlands

summaries.en: The day-to-day policy of a trust office with its seat in the Netherlands must be determined by at least two natural persons, who carry out that work from the Netherlands. De Nederlandsche Bank may grant an exemption where the applicant shows that the rule cannot reasonably be met and the interests it protects are safeguarded.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run the trust office with sound and controlled operations and a periodic integrity risk analysis
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 14 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=14

titles.en: Run the trust office with sound and controlled operations and a periodic integrity risk analysis

summaries.en: A trust office with its seat in the Netherlands must pursue an adequate policy and organise its operations so that the business is carried on soundly and in a controlled way, in line with the act's rules on client due diligence and record keeping. It must periodically analyse the risks to the integrity of its operations and have procedures, processes and measures that mitigate the risks it identifies.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an independent compliance function and an independently performed audit function
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 15 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=15

titles.en: Keep an independent compliance function and an independently performed audit function

summaries.en: A trust office with its seat in the Netherlands must have an independent and effective compliance function that checks its compliance with the law and with its own internal rules. It must ensure that an audit function is performed independently, which checks compliance with the act, the anti-money laundering act and the Sanctions Act 1977 and the work of the compliance function.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give no tax advice and serve no client that carries out tax advice from the trust office's own group
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 17, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=17

titles.en: Give no tax advice and serve no client that carries out tax advice from the trust office's own group

summaries.en: A trust office with its seat in the Netherlands may not give tax advice, and may not provide trust services to a client that give effect to tax advice the client received from a person or company belonging to the same group as the trust office.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report on the trust office's operations to De Nederlandsche Bank every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 18 lid 1, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=18

titles.en: Report on the trust office's operations to De Nederlandsche Bank every year

summaries.en: A trust office with its seat in the Netherlands must give De Nederlandsche Bank a report on its operations every year, or more often where supervision of compliance with the act requires it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell De Nederlandsche Bank about incidents without delay, act on them and record them
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 20 lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=20

titles.en: Tell De Nederlandsche Bank about incidents without delay, act on them and record them

summaries.en: A trust office with its seat in the Netherlands must inform De Nederlandsche Bank without delay of an incident, meaning conduct or an event that seriously endangers the integrity of its business. It must take appropriate measures to control the risks that arose and prevent a repeat, and must keep an administrative record of incidents and of the measures taken.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Enter no relationship and provide no trust service before client due diligence is complete
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 23 lid 1 en 3, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=23

titles.en: Enter no relationship and provide no trust service before client due diligence is complete

summaries.en: A trust office may not enter a business relationship or provide a trust service unless it, or an introducing institution, has carried out the client due diligence the act prescribes with the required result and beyond reasonable doubt as to its accuracy and completeness, and the data used have been recorded and are held by the trust office. If it cannot meet the due diligence rules for a business relationship, it must end that relationship.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide no trust service where a client, object company or beneficial owner is based in Russia, Belarus or a listed high-risk or non-cooperative state
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 23a lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=23a

titles.en: Provide no trust service where a client, object company or beneficial owner is based in Russia, Belarus or a listed high-risk or non-cooperative state

summaries.en: A trust office may not provide a trust service where clients, object companies or their ultimate beneficial owners live or are established in the Russian Federation, the Republic of Belarus, a state the European Commission has designated as higher risk for money laundering or terrorist financing, or a state on the EU list of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions. The ban does not apply to a natural person who is a national or holds a residence permit of an EU or EEA state or Switzerland, nor while the person or entity is one designated under the Sanctions Act 1977. When a country is added to one of the lists, the trust office must comply within three months.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record the client due diligence data, keep them current and store them for five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 37, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=37

titles.en: Record the client due diligence data, keep them current and store them for five years

summaries.en: A trust office must record the data it used for client due diligence and, in a retrievable way, the identification data listed in art. 33 of the anti-money laundering act, and must take reasonable measures to keep them up to date. It must keep the data accessible for five years after the business relationship ends or after the trust service was provided.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Train everyone who works for the trust office and record a training programme every calendar year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, art. 67, text in force from 2025-03-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041583&artikel=67

titles.en: Train everyone who works for the trust office and record a training programme every calendar year

summaries.en: A trust office must ensure that all persons who work for it, as far as relevant to their tasks and in view of its risks, nature and size, know the rules of the act and receive periodic training that enables them to carry out its obligations in full. It must draw up and record a training programme for them every calendar year.

instruments.title: Add BW Boek 7, Book 7 of the Dutch Civil Code, for its consumer credit and payment transaction rules (Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7)
instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, first published in Stb. 1991, 600; consolidated text in force from 2026-10-08, read in its XML file; entry into force on 1992-01-01 read in the same file, in the title's source data (which name the same Staatsblad)

titles.en: Civil Code, Book 7: Special contracts

payload.implementsNote: CCD, Directive 2008/48/EC (the heading of Title 2a, section 1, says its provisions carry out that directive)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer the standard pre-contract credit information in good time
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:60 lid 1 en 3, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=60

titles.en: Give the consumer the standard pre-contract credit information in good time

summaries.en: A creditor or, where one is involved, the credit intermediary must give the consumer, in good time before the consumer is bound by a credit agreement or an offer, the pre-contractual information that Articles 5 and 6 of the Consumer Credit Directive 2008/48/EC prescribe, in the manner those articles prescribe. A creditor or intermediary that does not do so commits an unfair commercial practice.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Put the consumer credit agreement on a durable medium with the required contents and give the consumer a copy
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:61 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=61

titles.en: Put the consumer credit agreement on a durable medium with the required contents and give the consumer a copy

summaries.en: A consumer credit agreement must be entered into on paper or another durable medium, and the creditor must give the consumer a copy and keep one itself. The agreement must state clearly and concisely the items the article lists, among them the type and total amount of credit, its duration, the borrowing rate and the conditions for changing it, the annual percentage rate of charge and the total amount payable, the amount and number of payments, the consequences of default, the right of withdrawal, the right of early repayment and the out-of-court complaint procedures.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Honour the consumer's fourteen-day right to withdraw from a credit agreement
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:66 lid 1, 3 en 4, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=66

titles.en: Honour the consumer's fourteen-day right to withdraw from a credit agreement

summaries.en: A consumer may withdraw from a credit agreement without giving reasons within fourteen calendar days after the agreement is concluded or, if later, after receiving the contract terms and information. The creditor may then claim only the capital with the interest accrued at the agreed borrowing rate until repayment, which is due within 30 calendar days of the notice, and non-refundable charges it paid to a public body. The right does not apply to securities credit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept early repayment of consumer credit at any time and cap the compensation charged for it
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:68, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=68

titles.en: Accept early repayment of consumer credit at any time and cap the compensation charged for it

summaries.en: A consumer may repay a credit agreement in full or in part at any time and is then entitled to a reduction of the total cost of credit for the remaining term. The creditor may charge fair and objectively justified compensation only for a repayment within a fixed borrowing rate period, of at most 1 per cent of the amount repaid early, or 0.5 per cent where one year or less remains, and never more than the interest for the remaining term; above 75,000 euros it may charge more if it shows a greater loss. No compensation is due where an insurance policy meant to guarantee repayment pays, or on an authorised overdraft.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep home loan advertising fair and clear and include the standard information whenever a rate or cost is shown
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:120, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=120

titles.en: Keep home loan advertising fair and clear and include the standard information whenever a rate or cost is shown

summaries.en: Advertising for credit secured on residential property must be fair, clear and not misleading and may not raise false expectations about the availability or the cost of credit. Advertising that states an interest rate or any figure on the cost of credit must contain the standard information of the Mortgage Credit Directive 2014/17/EU, clearly legible or audible, explained with a representative example and with a concise and proportionate warning of the specific risks. A creditor that does not comply commits an unfair commercial practice.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give a home loan applicant the personalised standard information sheet and a binding offer that stays open fourteen days
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:122 lid 1, 2, 3 en 5, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=122

titles.en: Give a home loan applicant the personalised standard information sheet and a binding offer that stays open fourteen days

summaries.en: For credit secured on residential property, the creditor or the credit intermediary must give the consumer, without delay after receiving the consumer's details and well before the consumer is bound, personalised information for comparing the credit products on the market, on paper or another durable medium in the model set by the conduct of business decree under the financial supervision act. A binding offer is made in the same way with that model, and the agreement cannot come into being until the consumer has received a copy of the draft agreement with the binding offer and been told that the offer binds the creditor for fourteen days.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell a home borrower of a change in the borrowing rate before it takes effect
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:128, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=128

titles.en: Tell a home borrower of a change in the borrowing rate before it takes effect

summaries.en: The creditor must inform the consumer on paper or another durable medium of a change in the borrowing rate before it takes effect, stating at least the amount of the payments due under the new rate and any change in their number or frequency. The parties may agree on periodic information instead where the change follows a reference rate that is made public and is available at the creditor's premises, and where the rate is set by auction on the capital markets the creditor informs the consumer of the procedure and its possible effect in good time before the auction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Invite a home borrower in arrears to talk and wait two months before announcing enforcement
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:128a, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=128a

titles.en: Invite a home borrower in arrears to talk and wait two months before announcing enforcement

summaries.en: Where a consumer is in default under a credit agreement secured on residential property, the creditor may not give notice of enforced sale until at least two months have passed since the claim fell due and it has personally invited the consumer to discuss the arrears, unless this cannot reasonably be asked of it. The compensation the consumer owes for the default, apart from statutory interest, may not exceed what is needed to make good the creditor's loss.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Propose changes to a payment framework contract at least two months before they take effect
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:517 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=517

titles.en: Propose changes to a payment framework contract at least two months before they take effect

summaries.en: A payment service provider must propose every change to the framework contract and to the prescribed information and conditions at least two months before its intended start date, on paper or another durable medium, in clear and easily understandable words, and the user may accept or reject it before that date. Where deemed acceptance has been agreed, the provider must tell the user that silence counts as acceptance and that a user who rejects the change may end the contract free of charge at any time before the change takes effect. Where the user is not a consumer, the parties may agree otherwise (art. 7:550).

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a payment instrument's security credentials from others and block the instrument once loss is reported
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:525 lid 1, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=525

titles.en: Keep a payment instrument's security credentials from others and block the instrument once loss is reported

summaries.en: A payment service provider that issues a payment instrument must ensure that its personalised security credentials are not accessible to anyone but the entitled user, must not send an instrument unrequested except as a replacement, and must make sure that appropriate means are available at all times for the user to report loss, theft or misuse free of charge or to ask for unblocking. It must prevent any use of the instrument once the report is made and, on request, give the user the means to prove the report for eighteen months afterwards.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refund an unauthorised payment transaction by the end of the next working day
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:528 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=528

titles.en: Refund an unauthorised payment transaction by the end of the next working day

summaries.en: The payer's payment service provider must refund the amount of an unauthorised payment transaction to the payer immediately, and in any case by the end of the working day after it noticed or was told of the transaction, and must restore the debited account to the state it would have been in, with a credit value date no later than the date of the debit. This does not apply where the provider has reasonable grounds to suspect fraud and reports those grounds in writing to the Authority for the Financial Markets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Answer a request to refund a payee-initiated payment within ten working days
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:531, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=531

titles.en: Answer a request to refund a payee-initiated payment within ten working days

summaries.en: A payer may ask for the refund provided for in art. 7:530 of an authorised payment initiated by or through the payee for eight weeks after the funds were debited. Within ten working days of the request the payment service provider must either refund the full amount of the transaction or refuse, giving its reasons and naming the dispute resolution body the payer can turn to. Where the payer is not a consumer, the parties may agree that the article does not apply (art. 7:550).

obligations.title: Add the duty: Credit the payee's payment service provider by the end of the next working day
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:537 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=537

titles.en: Credit the payee's payment service provider by the end of the next working day

summaries.en: The payer's payment service provider must ensure that the account of the payee's provider is credited with the amount of the payment transaction by the end of the working day after the payment order is received; for orders initiated on paper the period may be one working day longer. The payee's provider must value date the amount and make it available on the payee's account as soon as it has received the funds. The rule covers payments in euro and the other transactions listed in art. 7:536, and for other transactions unless agreed otherwise.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Value date a credit no later than the working day of receipt and a debit no earlier than the debit itself
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, art. 7:541, text in force from 2026-10-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005290&artikel=541

titles.en: Value date a credit no later than the working day of receipt and a debit no earlier than the debit itself

summaries.en: The credit value date for the payee's payment account may be no later than the working day on which the amount of the transaction is credited to the account of the payee's payment service provider, which must put the amount at the payee's disposal as soon as it is credited where there is no currency conversion on its side or only one between the euro and a member state currency or between two member state currencies. The debit value date for the payer's account may be no earlier than the moment the amount is debited from that account. Under art. 7:536 the article cannot be departed from.

instruments.title: Add BW Boek 6, Book 6 of the Dutch Civil Code, for its rules on financial contracts concluded at a distance and on unfair commercial practices (Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6)
instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6, BWBR0005289, first published in Stb. 1991, 600; consolidated text in force from 2026-07-16, read in its XML file; entry into force on 1992-01-01 read in the same file, in the title's source data (which name the same Staatsblad)

titles.en: Civil Code, Book 6: The law of obligations

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use no unfair commercial practices towards consumers
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6, BWBR0005289, art. 6:193b lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-07-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005289&artikel=193b

titles.en: Use no unfair commercial practices towards consumers

summaries.en: A trader acts unlawfully towards a consumer if it uses an unfair commercial practice: one that is contrary to the requirements of professional diligence and that appreciably impairs, or can impair, the average consumer's ability to take an informed decision, so that the consumer takes or may take a decision on a contract that would not otherwise have been taken. Misleading practices under art. 6:193c to 6:193g and aggressive practices under art. 6:193h and 6:193i are unfair in particular.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Design and provide online sales services to consumers in line with the accessibility requirements
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6, BWBR0005289, art. 6:230fb en 6:230fc, text in force from 2026-07-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005289&artikel=230fb

titles.en: Design and provide online sales services to consumers in line with the accessibility requirements

summaries.en: A service provider that provides e-commerce services to a consumer, meaning services provided at a distance through websites and mobile device-based services at the consumer's individual request with a view to concluding a contract, must design and provide them in line with the accessibility requirements of Directive (EU) 2019/882. It must draw up and keep the information on how the services meet the requirements, make information available to the public in a way that is accessible to persons with disabilities, apply procedures that keep the service compliant and take corrective measures at once where it is not. The duty does not apply to undertakings with fewer than 10 employees and an annual turnover or balance sheet total of at most 2 million euros, nor as far as compliance would fundamentally alter the service or impose a disproportionate burden.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Put a clearly visible withdrawal function on the online interface and confirm each withdrawal at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6, BWBR0005289, art. 6:230oa, text in force from 2026-07-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005289&artikel=230oa

titles.en: Put a clearly visible withdrawal function on the online interface and confirm each withdrawal at once

summaries.en: For a distance contract concluded through an online interface, including one on a financial product or service, the trader must ensure that the consumer can withdraw by submitting a withdrawal statement through a clearly visible and easily accessible function on that interface, labelled in unambiguous words and available throughout the withdrawal period. The function lets the consumer give or confirm their name, the details identifying the contract and the electronic means for the confirmation, and submit the statement through a confirmation function. The trader must confirm receipt without delay on a durable medium, with the content of the statement and the date and time it was submitted.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Let a consumer withdraw from a financial contract concluded at a distance or off premises within fourteen or thirty days
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6, BWBR0005289, art. 6:230x lid 1, 2, 4 en 7, text in force from 2026-07-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005289&artikel=230x

titles.en: Let a consumer withdraw from a financial contract concluded at a distance or off premises within fourteen or thirty days

summaries.en: A consumer may withdraw from a distance or off-premises contract on a financial product or service, without penalty and without giving reasons, within fourteen calendar days from the day the contract was concluded or, if later, the day the consumer received the information the financial undertaking must give under the financial supervision act. The period is thirty calendar days for life insurance of more than six months, funeral insurance in kind and tax-favoured pension products outside the pension acts, and it ends in any case twelve months and fourteen days after conclusion if the information was not received, unless the consumer was not told of the right. The right does not apply, among others, to products whose value depends on market movements during the period, insurance of less than a month, and contracts fully performed at the consumer's express request before withdrawal.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Charge only for what was actually supplied before withdrawal and repay the rest within thirty days
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6, BWBR0005289, art. 6:230y, text in force from 2026-07-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005289&artikel=230y

titles.en: Charge only for what was actually supplied before withdrawal and repay the rest within thirty days

summaries.en: Where a consumer withdraws under art. 6:230x, the financial undertaking may ask only for payment for the financial product or service actually supplied, in proportion to the full performance of the contract and never so high that it amounts to a penalty. It may ask for that payment only if it can show that the consumer was informed of it beforehand and that it started performance before the end of the withdrawal period at the consumer's express request. It must repay everything else it received from the consumer as soon as possible and within thirty calendar days of receiving the notice of withdrawal.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not canvass for money loans by personal visit or at group sales events
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6, BWBR0005289, art. 6:230z lid 1, 2 en 4, text in force from 2026-07-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005289&artikel=230z

titles.en: Do not canvass for money loans by personal visit or at group sales events

summaries.en: A creditor or credit intermediary may not try, by a personal visit or by promoting a money loan, a good or a service to a group of persons gathered for that purpose, to move another person to take part in a money loan as borrower, or have others do so. A visit that mainly results from the initiative of the person visited is not a personal visit for this purpose. A contract concluded in breach of the ban can be annulled by the consumer.

instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het consumentenkrediet, BWBR0004815, first published in Stb. 1990, 395; consolidated text in force from 2019-01-01, read in its XML file; entry into force on 1990-11-01 read in the same file, in the title's source data (which name Stb. 1990, 530)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not mediate a natural person's credit debts for payment unless the act exempts it
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het consumentenkrediet, BWBR0004815, art. 47 en 48 lid 1, text in force from 2019-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0004815&artikel=47

titles.en: Do not mediate a natural person's credit debts for payment unless the act exempts it

summaries.en: Debt mediation is forbidden: providing services in the course of a business or profession, other than by entering into a credit transaction, that aim at a settlement of a natural person's existing debts arising wholly or partly from credit transactions. The ban does not apply to mediation free of charge, by municipalities, municipal credit banks and institutions working for municipalities, by lawyers, court-appointed trustees and administrators, notaries, bailiffs and accountants, or by persons a decree designates.

titles.en: General Data Protection Regulation Implementation Act
