obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain the legal representative's consent for a data subject under sixteen or under guardianship
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringswet Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming, BWBR0040940, art. 5 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-09-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0040940&artikel=5

titles.en: Obtain the legal representative's consent for a data subject under sixteen or under guardianship

summaries.en: Where processing rests on consent and Article 8 of the GDPR does not apply, the consent of the legal representative is required in place of that of a data subject who is under sixteen. The same holds for a data subject placed under guardianship, administration or mentorship, as far as the matter is one the person is not competent to decide. Consent can be withdrawn at any time by the legal representative and by a data subject who has reached the age of twelve.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Process special categories of personal data only under an exception
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringswet Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming, BWBR0040940, art. 22, text in force from 2026-09-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0040940&artikel=22

titles.en: Process special categories of personal data only under an exception

summaries.en: Processing personal data that reveal race or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and processing genetic data, biometric data for unique identification, health data or data on a person's sex life or sexual orientation, is forbidden. The ban lifts, among other cases, where the data subject has given explicit consent for specified purposes, to protect vital interests, for data the data subject has manifestly made public, for legal claims, and under the further national exceptions of art. 23 to 30.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use biometric identification only where authentication or security makes it necessary
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringswet Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming, BWBR0040940, art. 29, text in force from 2026-09-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0040940&artikel=29

titles.en: Use biometric identification only where authentication or security makes it necessary

summaries.en: Biometric data may be processed to identify a person uniquely only if the processing is necessary for authentication or security purposes, and only as far as a substantial public interest in lawful access to certain places, buildings, services, products, information systems or work process systems makes it necessary.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Process personal data on criminal matters only on the grounds the act lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringswet Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming, BWBR0040940, art. 31 tot en met 33, text in force from 2026-09-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0040940&artikel=31

titles.en: Process personal data on criminal matters only on the grounds the act lists

summaries.en: Personal data on criminal convictions and offences may be processed only as far as art. 32 and 33 allow, among other grounds with explicit consent, for legal claims, and by a controller for its own purposes to assess a request by the data subject for a decision or a service or to protect its interests against offences committed or expected against it or its staff. Such data about the controller's own staff may be processed only under rules adopted through the procedure of the works councils act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the data protection officer keep complaints and requests confidential
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringswet Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming, BWBR0040940, art. 39, text in force from 2026-09-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0040940&artikel=39

titles.en: Have the data protection officer keep complaints and requests confidential

summaries.en: The data protection officer must keep secret what has come to the officer's knowledge through a complaint or a request from a data subject, unless the data subject agrees to disclosure.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give human intervention and a right to contest when taking automated decisions required by law
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringswet Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming, BWBR0040940, art. 40, text in force from 2026-09-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0040940&artikel=40

titles.en: Give human intervention and a right to contest when taking automated decisions required by law

summaries.en: The GDPR's ban on solely automated individual decisions does not apply where such decision-making, other than on the basis of profiling, is necessary to comply with a legal obligation on the controller or for a task in the public interest. The controller must then take suitable measures to protect the data subject's rights, freedoms and legitimate interests, which for a controller that is not a public body means at least the right to human intervention, the right to express a point of view and the right to contest the decision.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use a statutory identification number only for the purposes a law sets
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringswet Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming, BWBR0040940, art. 46, text in force from 2026-09-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0040940&artikel=46

titles.en: Use a statutory identification number only for the purposes a law sets

summaries.en: A number that a law prescribes for identifying a person may be used in processing personal data only to carry out that law or for purposes laid down by law.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report every reportable account, its holders and its balance to the tax administration each year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op de internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0003954, art. 10b lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-04-11; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003954&artikel=10b

titles.en: Report every reportable account, its holders and its balance to the tax administration each year

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must provide the Minister of Finance each year, for every reportable account it maintains, with the name, address, state of tax residence and tax identification number of each reportable account holder, the date and place of birth of a natural person, the same data for an entity and for its reportable beneficial owners with their role, whether a valid self-certification was given, the account number and type and whether the account is joint, new or pre-existing, its own name and identification number, and the balance or value at the end of the year or the fact that the account was closed. Each amount is reported with its currency.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the income paid or credited to each reportable account each year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op de internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0003954, art. 10c lid 1, text in force from 2026-04-11; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003954&artikel=10c

titles.en: Report the income paid or credited to each reportable account each year

summaries.en: Beside the account data, a reporting financial institution must report each year for a custodial account the total gross interest, dividends and other income generated by the assets and the total gross proceeds of sales or redemptions credited to the account, for a depository account the total gross interest paid or credited, and for other accounts the total gross amount paid or credited to the holder for which the institution is the obligor or debtor.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make reasonable efforts to obtain missing tax numbers and birth dates for pre-existing accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op de internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0003954, art. 10d, text in force from 2026-04-11; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003954&artikel=10d

titles.en: Make reasonable efforts to obtain missing tax numbers and birth dates for pre-existing accounts

summaries.en: For a pre-existing account a reporting financial institution need not report a tax identification number or date of birth that is not in its records and that it is not otherwise required to collect. It must make reasonable efforts to obtain them by the end of the second calendar year after the year in which the account was identified as reportable, and whenever the account information has to be updated under the anti-money laundering act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report reportable cross-border tax arrangements to the tax administration
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op de internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0003954, art. 10h lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-04-11; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003954&artikel=10h

titles.en: Report reportable cross-border tax arrangements to the tax administration

summaries.en: An intermediary that is tax resident in the Netherlands, provides the services through a Dutch permanent establishment, is incorporated under or governed by Dutch law, or is registered with a Dutch professional association for legal, tax or advisory services must give the Minister of Finance the listed information it knows, holds or controls about a reportable cross-border arrangement, including the parties and their tax numbers, the hallmarks, a summary of the arrangement and its value. For marketable arrangements it must draw up and file a periodic report every three months with the new reportable information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report crypto-asset users and their transactions to the tax administration by 31 January each year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op de internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0003954, art. 10ob lid 1, 3 tot en met 5 en 12, text in force from 2026-04-11; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003954&artikel=10ob

titles.en: Report crypto-asset users and their transactions to the tax administration by 31 January each year

summaries.en: A reporting crypto-asset service provider that is authorised by or notified to the Authority for the Financial Markets under MiCA, Regulation (EU) 2023/1114, or that has one of the other links with the Netherlands the article lists, must report to the Minister of Finance its own identification data, the data it must collect and verify on each reportable user and on the reportable beneficial owners of a user, and, for each type of reportable crypto-asset, the aggregated data on the reportable transactions carried out during the calendar year. It reports every year by 31 January of the calendar year after the year the data relate to.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the administration and its data carriers for seven years in a form the tax inspector can check
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, BWBR0002320, art. 52 lid 1, 4 en 6, text in force from 2026-10-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0002320&artikel=52

titles.en: Keep the administration and its data carriers for seven years in a form the tax inspector can check

summaries.en: A party required to keep records, which includes every legal body, must keep an administration of its financial position and of everything concerning its business in such a way, and keep the books, documents and other data carriers belonging to it in such a way, that its rights and obligations and the data relevant to taxation are clear from it at all times. It must keep the data carriers for seven years unless a tax act provides otherwise, and organise and keep them so that the inspector can check them within a reasonable period, giving the cooperation and insight needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the tax inspector the information asked for about the taxation of third parties
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, BWBR0002320, art. 53 lid 1, text in force from 2026-10-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0002320&artikel=53

titles.en: Give the tax inspector the information asked for about the taxation of third parties

summaries.en: A party required to keep records must, when the inspector asks, provide the data and information and make available the books, documents and other data carriers that may be relevant to the taxation of third parties and to the taxes it is required to withhold, under the same rules that apply to information about its own taxation. The information must be given clearly, definitely and without reservation, in the form and within the period the inspector sets (art. 49).

obligations.title: Add the duty: Deliver the designated tax data to the inspector on the firm's own initiative, with the citizen service number
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, BWBR0002320, art. 53 lid 2 en 3, text in force from 2026-10-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0002320&artikel=53

titles.en: Deliver the designated tax data to the inspector on the firm's own initiative, with the citizen service number

summaries.en: The parties required to keep records that are designated by or under a tax act must provide the inspector, on their own initiative and according to the rules set, with the designated data and information that may be relevant to the levying of tax. They must state with the data the citizen service number of the person to whom the data relate.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Enable the co-owners of a collective deposit to exercise the voting rights on their securities
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet giraal effectenverkeer, BWBR0003109, art. 15, text in force from 2023-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003109&artikel=15

titles.en: Enable the co-owners of a collective deposit to exercise the voting rights on their securities

summaries.en: An intermediary that keeps a collective deposit must, where a co-owner so wishes, ensure that the co-owners can exercise the voting right attached to the securities, each for the quantity for which the co-owner shares in the securities held.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Answer an issuer's request to identify its shareholders without delay or pass it down the custody chain
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet giraal effectenverkeer, BWBR0003109, art. 49b lid 2, 4 en 5, text in force from 2023-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003109&artikel=49b

titles.en: Answer an issuer's request to identify its shareholders without delay or pass it down the custody chain

summaries.en: A party in the custody chain with its seat in the Netherlands that receives an issuer's request for the name, address, legal entity identifier where there is one and e-mail address of shareholders, with their holding, the classes of securities and the date since which they are held, must give the requested data without delay to the issuer or the third party it has designated. If it does not hold all the data, it must pass the request on without delay to the parties in the chain for which it keeps the securities.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pass company information to shareholders and shareholders' instructions to the issuer without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet giraal effectenverkeer, BWBR0003109, art. 49da lid 2, 3 en 5, text in force from 2023-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003109&artikel=49da

titles.en: Pass company information to shareholders and shareholders' instructions to the issuer without delay

summaries.en: A party in the custody chain with its seat in the Netherlands that receives from an issuer the information shareholders need to exercise their rights, or the notice of where it is on the issuer's website, must provide it without delay to the shareholder or the third party the shareholder has designated, or to the next parties in the chain where it does not hold the securities directly for the shareholder. Information it receives from a shareholder on the exercise of rights must be passed to the issuer without delay, following the shareholder's instructions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Facilitate the exercise of shareholders' rights
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet giraal effectenverkeer, BWBR0003109, art. 49db lid 1, text in force from 2023-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003109&artikel=49db

titles.en: Facilitate the exercise of shareholders' rights

summaries.en: Parties in the custody chain with their seat in the Netherlands must facilitate the exercise of shareholders' rights at least by making the arrangements needed for the shareholder or a designated third party to exercise the rights personally, or by exercising the rights for the shareholder on the shareholder's express authorisation and instruction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish the charges for each shareholder identification and information service
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet giraal effectenverkeer, BWBR0003109, art. 49dc, text in force from 2023-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003109&artikel=49dc

titles.en: Publish the charges for each shareholder identification and information service

summaries.en: Parties in the custody chain with their seat in the Netherlands must publish, separately for each service offered under the act's chapter on shareholder identification, information and rights, the charges that may be billed to shareholders, companies or other parties in the chain. The charges must be non-discriminatory and proportionate to the costs actually incurred.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record which corresponding positions belong to the segregated derivatives assets of clients
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet giraal effectenverkeer, BWBR0003109, art. 49g lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2023-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0003109&artikel=49g

titles.en: Record which corresponding positions belong to the segregated derivatives assets of clients

summaries.en: An intermediary that enters into or manages derivatives positions for clients must record in its administration which corresponding positions belong to the derivatives assets, and for each client position which corresponding position was entered into. The derivatives assets serve only to meet the claims arising from the related client positions and from the collateral provided for them.

instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Bankwet 1998, BWBR0009508, first published in Stb. 1998, 200; consolidated text in force from 2026-09-22, read in its XML file; entry into force on 1998-06-01 read in the same file, in the title's source data (which name Stb. 1998, 244)

titles.en: Bank Act 1998

obligations.title: Add the duty: Check all euro banknotes received for fitness before recirculating them and hand unfit notes to De Nederlandsche Bank
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Bankwet 1998, BWBR0009508, art. 9a lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0009508&artikel=9a

titles.en: Check all euro banknotes received for fitness before recirculating them and hand unfit notes to De Nederlandsche Bank

summaries.en: Credit institutions, payment service providers and the other economic operators named in Article 6(1) of the EU regulation on counterfeiting must check all euro banknotes they receive for fitness for circulation before putting them back into circulation, following the procedures the European Central Bank has laid down. Banknotes unfit for circulation must be handed in to De Nederlandsche Bank, which reimburses their face value.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Supply the data De Nederlandsche Bank asks for its statistics and financial stability tasks within the period set
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Bankwet 1998, BWBR0009508, art. 9d lid 2 en 3, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0009508&artikel=9d

titles.en: Supply the data De Nederlandsche Bank asks for its statistics and financial stability tasks within the period set

summaries.en: Where the registers of public bodies do not give De Nederlandsche Bank the data it needs for its tasks of promoting financial stability and compiling statistics, it may ask the categories of undertakings, professionals, institutions and legal persons designated by decree for data set by decree, other than personal data. They must supply the data at the Bank's request within the period the decree sets, and cannot invoke a duty of confidentiality unless it rests on international rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay the supervisor's fee for a one-off act
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet bekostiging financieel toezicht 2019, BWBR0041548, art. 14 lid 1, text in force from 2026-08-15; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041548&artikel=14

titles.en: Pay the supervisor's fee for a one-off act

summaries.en: A person owes the supervisor a fee for a one-off act it carries out for that person. A ministerial regulation sets the acts for which a fee is due and the cost or the way it is calculated.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay the yearly charge for ongoing supervision
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet bekostiging financieel toezicht 2019, BWBR0041548, art. 15 lid 1, text in force from 2026-08-15; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041548&artikel=15

titles.en: Pay the yearly charge for ongoing supervision

summaries.en: Each year the supervisor charges a person under its supervision an amount for the costs of supervision. The total charged follows from the supervisor's budget and the previous year's result, and a decree sets who counts as supervised, the categories and how the costs are divided among them and calculated per person.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Follow the Civil Code's rules for contracts between traders and consumers, before and after the contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming, BWBR0020586, art. 8.2a, text in force from 2026-06-25; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020586&artikel=8.2a

titles.en: Follow the Civil Code's rules for contracts between traders and consumers, before and after the contract

summaries.en: A trader that enters into a contract covered by the Civil Code's section on contracts between traders and consumers (Book 6, Title 5, Section 2B), which includes distance and off-premises contracts on financial products and services, must comply with that section, and so must anyone who brings the contract about on the trader's behalf. The duty applies already before the consumer is bound by a contract or an offer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not hold a consumer to a general term that can be annulled under the Civil Code
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming, BWBR0020586, art. 8.3, text in force from 2026-06-25; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020586&artikel=8.3

titles.en: Do not hold a consumer to a general term that can be annulled under the Civil Code

summaries.en: A party that uses general terms and conditions in a contract with a consumer may not bind the consumer to a term that can be annulled under the Civil Code's section on general terms (Book 6, Title 5, Section 3).

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use no unfair commercial practices
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming, BWBR0020586, art. 8.8, text in force from 2026-06-25; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020586&artikel=8.8

titles.en: Use no unfair commercial practices

summaries.en: A trader may not use unfair commercial practices as defined in the Civil Code (Book 6, Title 3, Section 3A).

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the authority at once when an online sales service does not meet the accessibility requirements
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming, BWBR0020586, art. 8a.0, text in force from 2026-06-25; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020586&artikel=8a.0

titles.en: Tell the authority at once when an online sales service does not meet the accessibility requirements

summaries.en: A service provider that provides an e-commerce service must inform the Authority for Consumers and Markets or, as the case may be, the Authority for the Financial Markets immediately if the service does not meet the applicable accessibility requirements, stating the nature of the non-conformity and describing in detail all corrective measures taken.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess, document and keep for five years any claim that accessibility is a disproportionate burden
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming, BWBR0020586, art. 8a.1, text in force from 2026-06-25; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020586&artikel=8a.1

titles.en: Assess, document and keep for five years any claim that accessibility is a disproportionate burden

summaries.en: A service provider that relies on the Civil Code's exception for a fundamental alteration or a disproportionate burden must carry out an assessment against the criteria of Directive (EU) 2019/882, and where it relies on a disproportionate burden must renew the assessment at least every five years, when the service changes and when the authority asks. It must document the assessment, keep the results for five years after the service was provided on the market, give the authority a copy on request and inform the authority that it relies on the exception.

obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet financiële betrekkingen buitenland 1994, BWBR0006547, art. 7 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2013-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0006547&artikel=7

titles.en: Report the data De Nederlandsche Bank needs for the balance of payments, on time and truthfully

summaries.en: Everyone must give De Nederlandsche Bank, in line with the rules the Bank issues, the information and data relevant to compiling the Netherlands' balance of payments and to setting and carrying out the capital movement rules the act allows. The information must be provided on time, truthfully and in a way that does not mislead.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Let De Nederlandsche Bank verify reported data in the books and records
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet financiële betrekkingen buitenland 1994, BWBR0006547, art. 7 lid 3 en 4, text in force from 2013-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0006547&artikel=7

titles.en: Let De Nederlandsche Bank verify reported data in the books and records

summaries.en: Anyone who has to provide information and data for the balance of payments must, when required, enable De Nederlandsche Bank to satisfy itself of their accuracy from the books, documents and other data carriers, and whoever holds those books, documents and data carriers must produce them when required.
